title: Provisional fixture scorer
description: An issue #7 consumer runs the scorecard against an unmerged or locally regenerated fixture and reports a framework decision without an externally observed merge SHA.

title: Workspace path escape
description: A crafted absolute path, parent traversal, symlink component, or pre-existing foreign destination escapes the run root and redirects writes or cleanup into user-owned files.

title: Hash/read TOCTOU swap
description: Evidence or an artifact is replaced between validation, hashing, manifest assembly, and publication, allowing the manifest to certify bytes that are no longer present.

title: No-cache bootstrap exhaustion
description: An empty-cache install hangs, downloads an unbounded dependency graph, exhausts disk/log space, or exceeds runtime without terminating children and preserving useful evidence.

title: Interrupted release switch
description: A crash after some curated assets are staged or after pointer temp-write but before atomic switch exposes a partial or mixed 11-asset release or destroys the prior current release.

title: Ambient environment drift
description: A stale virtualenv, changed transitive resolver output, PYTHONPATH module shadow, locale/timezone, or ambient credential changes behavior while the harness still reports the immutable Git input.

title: Build evidence overwritten by docs
description: dbt docs generation replaces run_results.json, and downstream canonicalization records the wrong command lifecycle or drops warning/test failures from the golden oracle.

title: Checksum mislabeled as signature
description: A locally recomputable SHA-256 is presented as publisher authenticity or hosted signing, permitting a hostile replacement with internally consistent hashes to appear trusted.

title: Semantic drift hidden by totals
description: Row totals remain stable while one CSV byte, dbt edge, warning ID, mart schema/result, Rill weighting expression, Airflow edge, curated asset ID, or metadata FQN changes unnoticed.

title: Make registry ownership collision
description: The root include/help seam duplicates an existing target, defines a later issue's recipe, miscounts the 54-command registry, or changes existing Make target semantics.

title: Tracked evidence disclosure
description: A tracked fixture or evidence bundle includes credentials, private URLs, absolute home paths, raw PII-like identifiers, container/volume identifiers, or unredacted command output.

title: Invented promotion attribution
description: The promotion-trust contract joins incompatible mart grains and claims campaign causality for fulfillment delay, returns, or data-quality anomalies not supported by current data.

title: Mixed-generation current pointer
description: A reader observes a syntactically valid manifest whose 11 asset entries come from different data runs because generation coherence and exact asset-set validation are absent.

title: Score published before merge identity
description: A reviewer treats testedTreeSha or the discovery/attestation commit as the later merged fixture identity and publishes issue #7 scoring before the merge is externally observable.

title: Rollback cannot read evidence v1
description: A new evidence writer/schema is promoted, v1 reader support or the old schema is removed, and rollback/re-audit can no longer validate previously retained golden evidence.
